lanternBomb.name: Lantern Bomb
lanternBomb.desc: Hurl a lantern bomb: 20 damage to up to 40 foes in the blast, 100 to a boss.

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.desc: Scatter caltrops on the path. They pop the next 20 layers that cross them (1 damage each), then vanish. Gone after the next round at the latest.

frostTrap.name: Frost Trap
frostTrap.desc: Freezes the next 15 foes that cross it for 3 seconds, then vanishes. Bosses and Emberlings are immune.

timeWarp.name: Time Warp
timeWarp.desc: All foes move 50% slower for 10 seconds (bosses 25%).

lanternOil.name: Lantern Oil
lanternOil.desc: +25% gold from pops for the rest of this round and the whole next round.

heroBoost.name: Hero Boost
heroBoost.desc: Wren gains 3 levels (max. 20). Requires Wren on the field.

instaWarden:ranger.name: Insta-Warden: Ranger
instaWarden:ranger.desc: Place a fully built Ranger (2-0-3) for free. Ignores tier locks. Sells for nothing.

instaWarden:bombardier.name: Insta-Warden: Bombardier
instaWarden:bombardier.desc: Place a fully built Bombardier (3-0-1) for free. Ignores tier locks. Sells for nothing.

instaWarden:frostcaller.name: Insta-Warden: Frostcaller
instaWarden:frostcaller.desc: Place a fully built Frostcaller (0-2-3) for free. Ignores tier locks. Sells for nothing.
